title: CTRL AND A CLICK MOVES ONE ITEM FROM THE STASH TO THE BACKPACK
why: His pick from the feature list: quick move with CTRL. On the Stash screen CTRL and a click on a stash item packs one of it into the backpack, and the key bar names it. SHIFT still packs the whole stack, and a click on a backpack item still puts one back.
